description: Read-only; changes nothing. Returns one document of one entry: a document the module's own system prints (e.g. its invoice, in the book's own layout) or one designed in Inistate. Each layout offered is its own document: name the one the user means in `document`. With several and none named, the answer is document_required with documents[] to choose from or ask about. as "link" (default) gives a link that lasts up to an hour and renders the document when opened: give it to the user. as "file" returns the file itself as an embedded resource (max 4 MB; over that, ask for a link). Links are for documents the system prints, so a document designed in Inistate comes as a file. Formats: pdf, docx, rtf, xlsx, xls, html, mht, csv, txt, png, as each document offers; omit format for its own.

as.description: link (default): a link that lasts up to an hour; file: the file itself, max 4 MB

document.description: The document's name or id; optional when the entry has one document

entry.description: The entry's document number (e.g. IV-00123) or its entry ID

format.description: One of the document's formats; omit for its default

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID for this call. The MCP keeps no workspace between calls, so pass it every time; omit only when INISTATE_WORKSPACE_ID is configured.

name: get_document
title: Get Document
